summary: Iteration 4 tested all 6 new features: (1) cert search+clear+empty state, (2) /resume page + navigation + summary link, (3) visitor analytics (visit/cert-view/summary endpoints + admin panel), (4) scroll progress bar, (5) CCNA 200-301 verify removed. critical_code_review_comments: Analytics endpoints look clean; consider capping page_visits collection (unbounded growth) with a TTL index or cap collection.
POST /api/analytics/cert-view does not verify cert exists — silently no-ops if cert_id is invalid. Not harmful but consider returning 404 for observability.
server.py CORS still uses allow_credentials=True with allow_origins='*' fallback when CORS_ORIGINS env is unset (carried forward from iteration_3).
Iteration_3 stale tests updated to reflect new behavior (CCNA verify_url removed, __CLEAR__ sentinel for clearing verify_url).
